description: Save a finished scrape as a spreadsheet file on this computer and return its path. The API serves the file itself (authenticated), so this tool downloads it rather than returning a link. Only works once the scrape status is done. The file uses the full column layout (every column, blanks where unknown). Files are never overwritten: an existing name gets a -1, -2... suffix.

directory.description: Absolute directory to save into. Defaults to HUBERTINO_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else ~/Downloads, else the system temp directory.

scrapeId.description: The scrape id returned by start_scrape or list_scrapes (a UUID).

name: download_export
title: Download scrape as CSV/XLSX
